statusLegend.in_progress: This is active or partially implemented and still needs evidence.
statusLegend.blocked: A recorded blocker prevents safe progress.
statusLegend.passing: Required verification passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Repository harness baseline
features.userVisibleBehavior: Future agent sessions can restart from AGENTS.md, read the harness files, and run the standard baseline without guessing current direction.
evidence: 2026-06-06 bash harness/init.sh passed before the current cleanup: git diff --check, npm run build, npm run test:agent-benchmark.
features.notes: Historical May evidence has been removed from this required-read file to prevent old decisions from steering new work. Use git history if old release evidence is needed.

features.title: Module-native AI and records-first information architecture
features.userVisibleBehavior: The app should center on Records as the default home, with bottom navigation targeting 记录 / 相册 / 账本 / 我的 and AI presented inside modules instead of as an independent chat center.
verification: Manual screenshot review for mobile bottom navigation and Records first screen
features.notes: Independent chat and reminder tabs are not target IA. Model selection and deep/fast mode should not be user-facing settings.

features.title: Tool-first Agent write path for records and ledger
features.userVisibleBehavior: When AI says something was recorded or created as pending, the matching backend state must already exist. Records and ledger writes should come from model-selected controlled tools, not from post-hoc regex/effect fallback.
verification: Targeted backend tests for Agent action tools and AppState persistence
features.notes: P0 scope is records and ledger only: feeding direct write, growth measurement pending, expense pending. AI reminder/todo tools are out of scope.

features.title: Chinese model-context harness and bad-case benchmark
features.userVisibleBehavior: The model receives current time, baby/family context, recent records, recent messages, available capabilities, and Chinese bad-case guidance before it decides how to respond.
verification: Bounded live model checks when changing harness behavior
evidence: harness/agent-model-context-harness.md is the current human-readable harness.
docs/agent-harness-model-comparison-2026-06-06.md records DeepSeek, Doubao, and Codex comparison evidence.
features.notes: Harness may be Markdown/Chinese; only machine tool parameter schemas need JSON Schema.

features.title: Mobile frontend verification gate
features.userVisibleBehavior: UI and interaction changes are verified across desktop and mobile viewports, not only by build success.
evidence: docs/frontend-verification.md defines the current UI verification contract.
features.notes: Any navigation, Records, Album, Ledger, My, voice input, composer, modal, keyboard, or safe-area change needs this gate.

features.title: Aliyun deployment and live smoke discipline
features.userVisibleBehavior: Cloud deployments keep production data intact and include behavior-specific probes beyond /api/health.
verification: Behavior-specific probe for the changed feature
evidence: Deployment safety and OTA rules are documented in AGENTS.md, docs/aliyun-ecs-deploy.md, and docs/mobile-updates.md.
features.notes: Do not sync or reset production data unless explicitly requested.

features.title: Native Android and iOS parity gate
features.userVisibleBehavior: Native-sensitive features such as camera, media, ASR, notification, haptics, keyboard, safe area, and OTA are validated with the appropriate sync/build/device evidence.
verification: Device probe when OS behavior is part of the claim
evidence: docs/native-capability-benchmark.md tracks native capability evidence and known gaps.
features.notes: Browser smoke cannot prove OS notification delivery, full-screen ringing, native camera/media picker behavior, or OTA apply.

features.title: Release hardening and trust readiness
features.userVisibleBehavior: Before broader beta or app-store release, account, security, privacy, backup, HTTPS, real-device, and trust disclosure gaps are explicitly closed.
features.notes: This is release infrastructure, not a reason to reintroduce May commercialization or daily-summary decisions.

features.title: Legal and third-party data-processing drafts
features.userVisibleBehavior: Privacy, user agreement, children information, and third-party data handling drafts match the current recording and companionship boundary.
verification: Review docs/legal/ before public release or broader beta
features.notes: Commercialization, Pro-trial, and May decision docs were deleted on 2026-06-06.
